### Observed differences

- The mid-process activities A19, A20 and A25 each ran in about 95 of 200 traces in the earlier window; in the later window they run in essentially every trace (about 199 of 200), roughly once per trace. [OCC003, OCC004, OCC005]
- The exit from A41 was redirected. Earlier, about 45 in 100 of A41's observed outgoing transitions went straight to A26 and about 37 in 100 to A19; in the later window about 96 in 100 go to A19, and the direct move to A26 has all but disappeared (about 0.5 in 100). [DIR006]
- The chain A41 → A19 → A25 → A20 → A26 became fixed and tightly spaced in the later window: A41 and A19 are one step apart in about 98 in 100 cases (about 79 in 100 earlier), A41 reaches A25 in two steps and A20 in three steps in about 95 in 100 cases each, and reaches A26 four steps later in about 94 in 100 (about 34 in 100 earlier). The edges A19 → A25 (about 97 in 100) and A25 → A20 (about 99 in 100) were already dominant earlier and stayed so. [LAG018, LAG020, LAG019, LAG021, DIR004, DIR005]
- Pairwise precedence became near-universal: in the later window A41 precedes A20 in about 96 in 100 traces (about 47 in 100 earlier), A25 precedes A20 in about 97 in 100 (earlier the two were mostly not in the same trace), A20 precedes A26 in about 97 in 100, and A19 and A25 each precede A26 in about 99 in 100. The A14/A15/A16 activities, which earlier co-occurred with A19/A20/A25 in only about 47 in 100 traces, now co-occur with them in essentially all traces. [REL024, REL022, REL023, REL025, REL020, REL019, REL010, REL017]
- A06 became far more prominent: it appears in about 146 of 200 later traces versus about 47 earlier, sits much earlier in the trace (median relative position about 0.21 versus 0.39), and its outgoing transitions now lead to A16 in about 88 in 100 cases, adjacent in about 97 in 100, where earlier they were scattered (A15 about 21 in 100, A47 about 15, A45 about 13, A16 about 8). A15 in turn routes to A06 in about 40 in 100 of its transitions (about 1 in 100 earlier), with A15 → A16 falling from about 94 to about 58 in 100. [OCC001, POS001, DIR001, LAG002, DIR003]
- Smaller shifts: A08 participation fell from about 40 to about 15 of 200 traces, and A26 — present in every trace in both windows — sits slightly later (mean relative position about 0.44 versus 0.41). [OCC002, POS002]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports the possibility that the segment A19 → A25 → A20 between A41 and A26 changed from an optional detour into an effectively mandatory part of the flow: in the earlier window these three activities each ran in about 95 of 200 traces and A41 bypassed them by moving directly to A26 in about 45 in 100 of its observed outgoing transitions, whereas in the later window they run in essentially every trace, A41 almost always continues to A19 first, and the order A41 → A19 → A25 → A20 → A26 holds with fixed one-to-four step distances. [OCC003, OCC004, OCC005, DIR006, REL020, REL022, REL025, LAG018, LAG021]

This is supported directly and consistently: participation, successor, precedence and distance indicators all describe the same consolidated sequence; A41 and A26 were already present in every trace in both windows, so the difference lies in the route between them rather than in new activities; and 62 items qualified against roughly 0.84 expected for an unchanged process, far beyond what chance produces — though most items re-describe one underlying sequence change rather than confirming it independently. [DIR006, REL024, POS002, OCC003, OCC004, OCC005, LAG018, LAG020, LAG021]

The evidence cannot rule out that the two windows differ in the mix of case types rather than in routing itself — for example, the earlier window could contain many cases of a variant that skips the segment — nor can it locate where between the windows the behaviour changed. [OCC003, DIR006]

Other differences: A06 appears to have been integrated into the main flow — about three times more frequent, earlier, now fed by A15 in about 40 in 100 of that activity's transitions and almost always followed immediately by A16 — which looks like a second consolidation upstream of A41 and is not part of the main hypothesis; A08 participation dropped to about 15 of 200 traces. [OCC001, POS001, DIR001, DIR003, LAG002, OCC002]
